title: A mark on a new floor

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: There’s a pale line across a board by the door. It looks like a scratch. Should I mark the board for replacement?
turns.zh: 門旁有塊地板橫過一道淺色線，看起來像刮痕。我該把那塊標成待更換嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Not yet. Shine the lamp along the board. A dent casts a little shadow. Then light it from the opposite end and see whether that shadow moves.
turns.zh: 先別。讓燈光沿著地板照。有凹痕就會投下小小的陰影。再從另一端照，看看陰影是否移動。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The line stays pale from both ends. There’s no shadow. I can see the same pattern on an unused board.
turns.zh: 從哪一端照，線條都一樣淺，也沒有陰影。一塊還沒鋪的地板也有同樣的紋路。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Keep the board. Note what you saw, so the next crew won’t flag it again.
turns.zh: 保留這塊地板。把你的觀察記下來，免得下一組人員又把它標成有問題。
